shloka_text: तत्सर्वमखिलेनाशु प्रस्थाप्य भरताग्रजः । हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं कृष्णसारं मुमोच ह ।। 7.92.1 ।।
transliteration: tatsarvamakhilenāśu prasthāpya bharatāgrajaḥ | hayaṃ lakṣaṇasampannaṃ kṛṣṇasāraṃ mumoca ha || 7.92.1 ||
translation: तत् that, सर्वम् all, अखिलेन completely, आशु quickly, प्रस्थाप्य having sent forth, भरताग्रजः Bharata's elder brother, हयं horse, लक्षणसम्पन्नं endowed with auspicious marks, कृष्णसारं black-spotted, मुमोच released, ह indeed.
explanation: Having quickly sent forth all those arrangements completely, Rama, Bharata's elder brother, then released the black-spotted horse, which was endowed with auspicious marks, for the sacrifice.
comments: Rama releases the sacrificial horse under Lakshmana's charge and proceeds to Naimisha -- the kings bring gifts, Bharata and Shatrughna provide for all, and the monkeys and rakshasas give so lavishly that none is poor or unsatisfied -- the matchless sacrifice, of boundless giving such as none had seen, continues more than a year.

shloka_text: ऋत्विग्भिर्लक्ष्मणं सार्धमश्वतन्त्रे नियोज्य च । ततो ऽभ्यगच्छत्काकुत्स्थः सह सैन्येन नैमिशम् ।। 7.92.2 ।।
transliteration: ṛtvigbhirlakṣmaṇaṃ sārdhamaśvatantre niyojya ca | tato 'bhyagacchatkākutsthaḥ saha sainyena naimiśam || 7.92.2 ||
translation: ऋत्विग्भिः with the priests, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, सार्धम् together with, अश्वतन्त्रे in the protection of the horse, नियोज्य having appointed, च and, ततः then, अभ्यगच्छत् proceeded towards, काकुत्स्थः Rama, सह with, सैन्येन the army, नैमिशम् Naimisha.
explanation: After appointing Lakshmana along with the priests to supervise the sacrificial horse, Rama then proceeded towards Naimisha with his army.

shloka_text: यज्ञवाटं महाबाहुर्दृष्ट्वा परममद्भुतम् । प्रबर्षमतुलं लेभे श्रीमानिति वचो ऽब्रवीत् ।। 7.92.3 ।।
transliteration: yajñavāṭaṃ mahābāhurdṛṣṭvā paramamadbhutam | prabarṣamatulaṃ lebhe śrīmāniti vaco 'bravīt || 7.92.3 ||
translation: यज्ञवाटं the sacrificial enclosure, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परमम् extremely, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रबर्षम् great joy, अतुलं incomparable, लेभे obtained, श्रीमान् the glorious one, इति thus, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having seen the extremely wonderful sacrificial enclosure, the glorious and mighty-armed Rama felt incomparable joy and spoke these words.

shloka_text: नैमिषे वसतस्तस्य सर्व एव नराधिपाः । आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च तान्रामः प्रत्यपूजयत् ।। 7.92.4 ।।
transliteration: naimiṣe vasatastasya sarva eva narādhipāḥ | āninyurupahārāṃśca tānrāmaḥ pratyapūjayat || 7.92.4 ||
translation: नैमिषे in Naimisha, वसतस्तस्य while he (Rama) was residing, सर्व एव all indeed, नराधिपाः kings, आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च brought gifts and, तान् them, रामः Rama, प्रत्यपूजयत् honored in return.
explanation: While Rama was residing in Naimisha, all the kings brought him gifts, and Rama, in turn, honored them.

shloka_text: उपकार्या महार्हाश्च पार्थिवानां महात्मनाम् । सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महामतिः ।। 7.92.5 ।।
transliteration: upakāryā mahārhāśca pārthivānāṃ mahātmanām | sānugānāṃ naraśreṣṭho vyādideśa mahāmatiḥ || 7.92.5 ||
translation: उपकार्या suitable dwellings, महार्हाश्च and very valuable, पार्थिवानां for the kings, महात्मनाम् great-souled, सानुगानां along with their followers, नरश्रेष्ठो the best among men (Rama), व्यादिदेश assigned, महामतिः the great-minded one.
explanation: The great-minded Rama, the best among men, arranged for valuable and suitable lodgings for the great kings and their retinues.

shloka_text: अन्नपानानि वस्त्राणि सानुगानां महात्मनाम् । भरतः सन्ददावाशु शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा ।। 7.92.6 ।।
transliteration: annapānāni vastrāṇi sānugānāṃ mahātmanām | bharataḥ sandadāvāśu śatrughnasahitastadā || 7.92.6 ||
translation: अन्नपानानि food and drinks, वस्त्राणि clothes, सानुगानां for those with their followers, महात्मनाम् great-souled, भरतः Bharata, सन्ददावाशु quickly distributed, शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा then along with Shatrughna.
explanation: Bharata, accompanied by Shatrughna, then swiftly provided food, drinks, and clothes for the great-souled kings and their followers.

shloka_text: वानराश्च महात्मानः सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा । विप्राणां प्रणताः सर्वे चक्रिरे परिवेषणम् ।। 7.92.7 ।।
transliteration: vānarāśca mahātmānaḥ sugrīvasahitāstadā | viprāṇāṃ praṇatāḥ sarve cakrire pariveṣaṇam || 7.92.7 ||
translation: वानराश्च and the Vanaras, महात्मानः great-souled, सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा then along with Sugriva, विप्राणां for the Brahmins, प्रणताः bowing down, सर्वे all, चक्रिरे performed, परिवेषणम् serving (food).
explanation: Then, all the great-souled Vanaras, led by Sugriva, humbly served food to the Brahmins.

shloka_text: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिर्बहुभिः स्रग्विभिर्वृतः । ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां पूजां चक्रे महात्मनाम् ।। 7.92.8 ।।
transliteration: bibhīṣaṇaśca rakṣobhirbahubhiḥ sragvibhirvṛtaḥ | ṛṣīṇāmugratapasāṃ pūjāṃ cakre mahātmanām || 7.92.8 ||
translation: बिभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, रक्षोभिर्बहुभिः by many Rakshasas, स्रग्विभिर्वृतः surrounded by garland-wearing ones, ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां of the sages of severe penance, पूजां worship, चक्रे performed, महात्मनाम् great-souled.
explanation: Vibhishana, accompanied by many garland-wearing Rakshasas, performed worship for the great-souled sages of severe penance.

shloka_text: एवं सुविहितो यज्ञो हयमेधो ऽभ्यवर्तत । लक्ष्मणेनागुप्ता च हयचर्या प्रवर्तत । ईदृशं राजसिंहस्य यज्ञप्रवरमुत्तमम् ।। 7.92.9 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ suvihito yajño hayamedho 'bhyavartata | lakṣmaṇenāguptā ca hayacaryā pravartata | īdṛśaṃ rājasiṃhasya yajñapravaramuttamam || 7.92.9 ||
translation: एवं thus, सुविहितो well-arranged, यज्ञो sacrifice, हयमेधो Ashvamedha, अभ्यवर्तत proceeded, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अगुप्ता unguarded, च and, हयचर्या the horse's wandering, प्रवर्तत proceeded, ईदृशं such, राजसिंहस्य of the lion among kings, यज्ञप्रवरम् the best of sacrifices, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: Thus, the well-arranged Ashvamedha sacrifice proceeded, and the horse's journey, unguarded by Lakshmana, also took place, such was this excellent and supreme sacrifice of the lion among kings.

shloka_text: नान्यः शब्दो ऽभवत्तत्र हयमेधे महात्मनः । छन्दतो देहि विस्रब्धो यावत्तुष्यन्ति याचकाः ।। 7.92.10 ।।
transliteration: nānyaḥ śabdo 'bhavattatra hayamedhe mahātmanaḥ | chandato dehi visrabdho yāvattuṣyanti yācakāḥ || 7.92.10 ||
translation: न not, अन्यः other, शब्दो sound, अभवत् was, तत्र there, हयमेधे in the Ashvamedha, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, छन्दतो according to desire, देहि give, विस्रब्धो confidently, यावत् until, तुष्यन्ति are satisfied, याचकाः supplicants.
explanation: In the great-souled Rama's Ashvamedha, no other sound was heard except "Give freely and confidently until the supplicants are satisfied."

shloka_text: तावत्सर्वाणि दत्तानि क्रतुमध्ये महात्मनः । विविधानि च गौडानि खाण्डवानि तथैव च ।। 7.92.11 ।।
transliteration: tāvatsarvāṇi dattāni kratumadhye mahātmanaḥ | vividhāni ca gauḍāni khāṇḍavāni tathaiva ca || 7.92.11 ||
translation: तावत् then, सर्वाणि all, दत्तानि were given, क्रतुमध्ये in the midst of the sacrifice, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, विविधानि various, च and, गौडानि jaggery sweets, खाण्डवानि sugar sweets, तथैव similarly, च and.
explanation: In the midst of the great-souled one's sacrifice, all sorts of things were given, including various jaggery sweets and sugar sweets.

translation: न not, निस्सृतं emerged, ओष्ठात् from the lips, वचनं word, यावत् until, अर्थिनाम् of the supplicants, तावत् then, वानररक्षोभिर् by monkeys and rakshasas, दत्तमेव indeed given, अभ्यदृश्यत was seen.
explanation: Before a word could even emerge from the lips of the supplicants, it was already seen to be given by the monkeys and rakshasas.

shloka_text: न कश्चिन्मलिनस्तत्र दीनो वा ऽप्यथ कृर्शतः । तस्मिन्यज्ञवरे राज्ञो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते ।। 7.92.13 ।।
transliteration: na kaścinmalinastatra dīno vā 'pyatha kṛrśataḥ | tasminyajñavare rājño hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛte || 7.92.13 ||
translation: न not, कश्चित् anyone, मलिनस् dirty, तत्र there, दीनो poor, वा or, अपि even, अथ moreover, कृशः emaciated, तस्मिन् in that, यज्ञवरे excellent sacrifice, राज्ञो of the king, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते filled with happy and well-nourished people.
explanation: In that excellent sacrifice of the king, which was filled with happy and well-nourished people, there was no one who was dirty, poor, or emaciated.

shloka_text: ये च तत्र महात्मानो मुनयश्चिरजीविनः । नास्मरंस्तादृशं यज्ञं नाप्यासीत् स कदाचन ।। 7.92.14 ।।
transliteration: ye ca tatra mahātmāno munayaścirajīvinaḥ | nāsmaraṃstādṛśaṃ yajñaṃ nāpyāsīt sa kadācana || 7.92.14 ||
translation: ये those who, च and, तत्र there, महात्मानो great-souled ones, मुनयः sages, चिरजीविनः long-lived, न not, अस्मरन् remembered, तादृशं such, यज्ञं a sacrifice, न not, अपि even, आसीत् was, सः that, कदाचन ever.
explanation: Even the great-souled, long-lived sages present there had never remembered or witnessed such a sacrifice before.

shloka_text: यः कृत्यवान्सुवर्णेन सुवर्णं लभते स्म सः । वित्तार्थी लभते वित्तं रत्नार्थी रत्नमेव च ।। 7.92.15 ।।
transliteration: yaḥ kṛtyavānsuvarṇena suvarṇaṃ labhate sma saḥ | vittārthī labhate vittaṃ ratnārthī ratnameva ca || 7.92.15 ||
translation: यः whoever, कृत्यवान् had a need, सुवर्णेन for gold, सुवर्णं gold, लभते obtained, स्म indeed, सः he, वित्तार्थी one desiring wealth, लभते obtained, वित्तं wealth, रत्नार्थी one desiring jewels, रत्नम् jewels, एव indeed, च and.
explanation: Whoever had a need for gold obtained gold, those desiring wealth obtained wealth, and those desiring jewels indeed obtained jewels.

shloka_text: रजतानां सुवर्णानामश्मनामथ वाससाम् । अनिशं दीयमानानां राशिः समुपदृश्यते ।। 7.92.16 ।।
transliteration: rajatānāṃ suvarṇānāmaśmanāmatha vāsasām | aniśaṃ dīyamānānāṃ rāśiḥ samupadṛśyate || 7.92.16 ||
translation: रजतानां of silver, सुवर्णानाम् of gold, अश्मनाम् of jewels, अथ and, वाससाम् of clothes, अनिशं constantly, दीयमानानां being given, राशिः a heap, समुपदृश्यते was seen.
explanation: Heaps of silver, gold, jewels, and clothes, constantly being distributed, were visible everywhere.

shloka_text: न शक्रस्य धनेशस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा । ईदृशो दृष्टपूर्वो न एवमूचुस्तपोधनाः ।। 7.92.17 ।।
transliteration: na śakrasya dhaneśasya yamasya varuṇasya vā | īdṛśo dṛṣṭapūrvo na evamūcustapodhanāḥ || 7.92.17 ||
translation: न not, शक्रस्य of Indra, धनेशस्य of Kubera, यमस्य of Yama, वरुणस्य of Varuna, वा or, ईदृशः such, दृष्टपूर्वः seen before, न not, एवम् thus, ऊचुः said, तपोधनाः the ascetics.
explanation: The ascetics declared that such a spectacle had never been seen before, not even in the realms of Indra, Kubera, Yama, or Varuna.

shloka_text: सर्वत्र वानरास्तस्थुः सर्वत्रैव च राक्षसाः । वासोधनान्नमर्थिभ्यः पूर्णहस्ता ददुर्भृशम् ।। 7.92.18 ।।
transliteration: sarvatra vānarāstasthuḥ sarvatraiva ca rākṣasāḥ | vāsodhanānnamarthibhyaḥ pūrṇahastā dadurbhṛśam || 7.92.18 ||
translation: सर्वत्र everywhere, वानराः monkeys, तस्थुः stood, सर्वत्र everywhere, एव indeed, च and, राक्षसाः rakshasas, वासः clothes, धन wealth, अन्नम् food, अर्थिभ्यः to the supplicants, पूर्णहस्ताः with full hands, ददुः gave, भृशम् abundantly.
explanation: Monkeys and rakshasas were present everywhere, giving clothes, wealth, and food abundantly with full hands to all who sought them.

shloka_text: ईदृशो राजसिंहस्य यज्ञः सर्वगुणान्वितः । संवत्सरमथो साग्रं वर्तते न च हीयते ।। 7.92.19 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśo rājasiṃhasya yajñaḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ | saṃvatsaramatho sāgraṃ vartate na ca hīyate || 7.92.19 ||
translation: ईदृशः such, राजसिंहस्य of the lion among kings, यज्ञः sacrifice, सर्वगुणान्वितः endowed with all good qualities, संवत्सरम् a year, अथो and, साग्रम् more than, वर्तते continues, न not, च and, हीयते diminishes.
explanation: Such a sacrifice of the lion among kings, endowed with all good qualities, continued for more than a year without diminishing. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 92 ।। Thus ends the ninety-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
